# harness_platform_idp_scorecard_check (Resource)

Resource for creating IDP scorecard checks.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "harness_platform_idp_scorecard_check" "readme" {
  identifier        = "readme_exists"
  name              = "README exists"
  description       = "Ensure the repository has a README file"
  rule_strategy     = "ALL_OF"
  default_behaviour = "FAIL"

  rules {
    data_source_identifier = "github"
    data_point_identifier  = "isFileExists"
    operator               = "=="
    value                  = "true"
    rule_description       = "Repository has a README"

    input_values {
      key   = "filePath"
      value = "README.md"
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `default_behaviour` (String) Default behaviour when the check cannot be evaluated. Valid values are PASS and FAIL.
- `identifier` (String) Unique identifier of the resource.
- `name` (String) Name of the resource.
- `rule_strategy` (String) How multiple rules are combined. Valid values are ALL_OF, ANY_OF, and ADVANCED.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the resource.
- `expression` (String) JEXL expression used for advanced check rules. Required when rule_strategy is ADVANCED.
- `fail_message` (String) Message shown when the check fails.
- `rule_description` (String) Description of the check rule set.
- `rules` (Block List) Basic rules evaluated by the check. Required when rule_strategy is ALL_OF or ANY_OF. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--rules))
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags to associate with the resource.

### Read-Only

- `custom` (Boolean) Whether this is a custom check. Always true for checks created through Terraform.
- `harness_managed` (Boolean) Whether the check is managed by Harness.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `percentage` (Number) Pass percentage for the check.

<a id="nestedblock--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Required:

- `data_point_identifier` (String) Identifier of the data point evaluated by the rule.
- `data_source_identifier` (String) Identifier of the data source used by the rule.
- `operator` (String) Comparison operator.

Optional:

- `identifier` (String) Identifier of the rule.
- `input_values` (Block List) Input values passed to the data point. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--rules--input_values))
- `rule_description` (String) Description of the rule.
- `value` (String) Value to compare against.

<a id="nestedblock--rules--input_values"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules.input_values`

Required:

- `key` (String) Input key.
- `value` (String) Input value.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an IDP scorecard check
terraform import harness_platform_idp_scorecard_check.example <check_id>
```
